name: Piscogavialis
sum: Large marine gryposuchine gavialid from the Miocene–Pliocene Pisco Formation of Peru, with exceptionally preserved skulls.
holotype: A nearly complete, three-dimensional skull from the Pisco Formation, Sacaco Basin, Peru (Kraus 1998).
material: The holotype with an associated mandible and postcranial bones, and other specimens.
biology: Lived along the south-east Pacific coast together with the smaller gavialid Sacacosuchus.
author: Kraus 1998
